subject.title: Workspaces: add version history and exact restore

question: Should this PR land as the narrower snapshot-versus-current history feature with three permanent public sync-Kysely helpers, or must it avoid that SDK expansion and/or complete the full linked-issue scope first?
rationale: Tests can establish implementation correctness, but they cannot decide the permanent external plugin API contract or whether generic Logbook routing and current-only comparison are sufficient product scope for closing the broader issue.

options.title: Narrow and stage the feature
options.body: Keep exact history restore, remove or narrow the broader issue closure, obtain explicit SDK-owner approval, and merge only after current-head browser proof.

options.title: Complete the full issue
options.body: Add arbitrary two-version comparison and session-specific provenance before retaining the current closing relationship.

options.title: Avoid the public SDK expansion
options.body: Move the synchronous query implementation behind a Workspaces-owned or approved bundled-runtime boundary before merge.

recommendation.title: Narrow and stage the feature
recommendation.body: Keep exact history restore, remove or narrow the broader issue closure, obtain explicit SDK-owner approval, and merge only after current-head browser proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice governs the permanent public plugin SDK and bundled-plugin product boundary rather than a mechanical implementation detail.
